items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: And Ricard Alexis played trumpet. Yeah. ... No, Guy Kelly was in the band before Alexis was there.

ctx.x: A lot of people, you know, somebody tells them something and they don't have it on tape, they just make a note and they spell it wrong and can't read their own writing. I'm that way myself. This is said Bill Matthews on trombone. That's in the Biloxi job. Is that right? Yeah.

But this wasn't the first band that we had when we played on that job. We had Oscar Ruzon, I mean Joe Ruzon playing tenor saxophone. And Clarence Hall playing alto saxophone. Bill Matthews playing trombone. Guy Kelly playing trumpet. And Saif Frazier played the drums. Simon Marrera played the bass violin. I played the banjo. And Ricard Alexis played trumpet. Yeah. But this person was Cecil. Not Caesar.
